Technology

Has technology effected humans social skills in a negative way? Technology has it's perks it could be a negative and positive thing. Technology for kids and teens mostly is a good thing to them but in reality it's not. Teens get depressed by social media, kids spend to much time watching shows on phones, TV, computers. Honestly anything that has a screen. I'm going to specifically talk about how damaging technology is in a negative way.

Teens get mentally and physically abused from social media. Prime example, depression. Depression for teens now in days is high. Our generation is so much different because i am living it. Who better to talk about technology being so negative then somebody who has lived it. Social media can take away a person's life it's sad to say that most teens depend on social media and aren't strong enough to fight it off. Teens watch other peoples lives how great there life is but in reality people paint a picture of what another person's life isn't. I can grantee you that probably 80% of teens, Adults, Kids etc... Can tell you technology is killing our generation.

Younger kids just like teens get less education because they spend to much time on smart phones watching videos, playing games. When they could be reading interacting, learning. This is where people don't see that there wrong. Has adults we should educate the future generation that not everything is on phones. That is not the real world.Children spend so much time watching videos that they forget kids do play outside. I remember going out with a whole bunch of kids when i was younger, running outside in the rain so happy, now having a smart phone has impacted me. It takes up your time that you don't socialize you just check your phone every 5 minutes or scroll through things for 20 minutes and do nothing. Examples of how bad smart phones are, my sister that is 25 years old she has a daughter age of 6. she bought her a iPod at the age of 1 so she can have something to watch shows like Elmo, Dora the explore has much as those shows are okay for children those ages can watch, if you don't show them that theres always a time, place, and limit to use the smart phone you will just show them that they can do whatever they want. Manners plays a big role in your children's life.

Cycos and rapists, murders etc.. Have more ability at there hands to take advantage of peoples lives. Technology is open to everybody and everywhere. We don't know if rapists have opened an account on social media. The high risks that there is of teens, adults letting a stranger follow them on there page is so high. Cycos can easily make a fake page and stalk a person for days. They can try and become friends to get closer to teens so teens can trust them.

Technology advances every year. Something new is always coming out and there's always the next person that want's it. They are more expensive each year. There is a saying "In with the new, out with the old."

People only want the new versions of the phones because other people have it.Teens, kids,adults base decisions on another humans decisions. Everybody has the iphone X, 8, 10, and i still have the 7 plus. I'm not going to lie that i do want to upgrade but not because somebody else has it but because my old phone has been through so much its glitching now.

In other ways technology can be useful and used has a good, positive way. You would have to know how to use it other wise it will take over you. I am an example of this because at some point it wanted to take over me. Has you get older your mindset changes and you wanna change things for the better. official_overall_rubric.4: Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.
official_overall_rubric.3: Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.
official_overall_rubric.2: Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.
